title: CMU Trains Football AI on NFL Film and Player Tracking

verified_claims: NFL provided official game footage and Next Gen Stats player tracking data
Research by Chenyan Xiong and Ron Yurko supported by NFL Forward Initiative
Two initial pretrained models trained separately on game footage and tracking data
Combining the modalities and predicting future plays are future research goals, not proven deployment

safeguards: No production deployment to NFL coaches announced
Training-data terms and public availability not established
Potential data leakage and temporal split evaluation discussed as methodological requirements, not experiment results
open_qa: Verify actual playback for both AWS videos
Inspect mobile and desktop viewport screenshots for overflow and caption legibility
